localLede: Each folder analysis is remembered here. Reopen one to resume without rescanning, or remove it from the list (your files stay intact).
clearAllLocalTitle: Clears the whole in-memory analysis list. No audio file is deleted.
clearAllSpotifyTitle: Clears the list of remembered imports
localEmptyBody: Go to My files, pick a music folder, then run analysis. One entry is kept per folder: re-runs update the same analysis (with a detection journal).
spotifyLede: Each likes import is listed here, by profile. Open one to activate that Spotify account and its dictionary (without restoring a frozen old snapshot).
spotifyEmptyNoneBody: Go to Spotify, connect your account and import your likes. Each update creates an entry here.
spotifyEmptyFilterBody: This filter shows nothing. Choose All profiles or another account.
reopenTip: Reopens this analysis in My files
removeLocalTip: Removes this analysis from history. Your audio files stay intact.
openInSpotifyTitle: Opens Spotify with the profile linked to this import (current dictionary)
forgetImportTitle: Removes this snapshot from history (active base on disk is not erased)
toastRemovedBody: This analysis no longer appears here. Tracks on disk were not modified.
toastClearedBody: All in-memory analyses were removed. No audio file was touched.
toastImportForgottenBody: The active base on disk is not erased.
